text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having finished their work for the day,
{0} and Djeeta make their way through town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とジータは仕事を終えて
ランドソルの街中を談笑しながら歩いていた。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you free tomorrow?
If you are, then how does having lunch together sound?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
明日は空いてる？
よかったら、
お昼ご飯一緒に食べない？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't celebrated you joining the crew yet,
so this seemed like a good opportunity.
Assuming you're fine with it, of course.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたが騎空団に入ったお祝いがまだだし、
親睦会をやってみたくて……
どうかな？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Wahoo! Thanks! Guess I'll see you tomorrow, then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！　
ありがとう！　
じゃあ、
また明日ね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day—
text_block_list.orig_text: 翌日──

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Over here!
You can't even imagine how hungry I am after skipping breakfast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい！　
こっちこっちー！
朝ご飯抜いてたからもうお腹ペコペコだよー……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: I got us a reservation yesterday, so let's speed along!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お店は昨日予約しておいたんだ。　
案内するね！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Djeeta!
I assume he's the new crewmate you were talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
ジータちゃん。
その人が新しい騎空士さん？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hello! 
Yup, that's him. He's super reliable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おばさん！　
こんにちは！
そうだよ、
とっても頼りになるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Djeeta!
I got your armor all fixed up, so come pick it up tomorrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータちゃん！　
　
防具の修理が終わったから、
明日にでも取りに来てくれ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Got it! Thanks, as always!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったー！　
　
ありがとー！

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Hey! It's Djeeta! What're you up to?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータだー！　
こんにちは！　
何してるのー？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey there!
I'm on my way to get lunch. With my new crewmate, even!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは！
今から騎空団の仲間と、
ご飯を食べに行くんだ。

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That sounds cool! I wanna join your crew as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいなー！　
　
あたしもきくうだんに入りたい！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Fine taste, my boy. ♪
You're more than welcome to. Once you're a bit older, of course.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいでしょー♪　
騎空団には、
大きくなったら入れてあげるね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been too long since I
moved to Landosol, but everyone here's so nice.
They've helped me out with all sorts of stuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この街には少し前から住んでるんだけど、
みんなとっても優しくて、
色々助けてくれるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I get along with them all really well.
If anything, they feel more like family than acquaintances.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
すぐに仲良くなって……
今はもう近所の人たちっていうより、
家族みたいに思ってる。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It's not just them, though.
I'd put you in that same category. We're crewmates, after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でもね、
あなたも私にとってはもう、
家族みたいなものなんだよ？　
同じ騎空団の仲間だもん！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Then again, though.
Feels like people would see us more as siblings when we're together.
But which one of us would be the elder one? Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも一緒にいると家族っていうより、
兄弟に見られそう。
あなたはどっちかな……？　
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I'll be honest, you feel more like the younger one. So yeah!
I'm henceforth your lovely and reliable older sister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんって感じはしないから……
弟かな！
これからは私のこと、
お姉ちゃんって呼んでもいいよ？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
What is it, oh brother of mine?
Hehe. Just kidding.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい。
どうしたの？
なんちゃって……
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I got caught up in the conversation there,
but here we are. Come on, in you go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
話してるうちに着いちゃった。
ここが予約したお店だよ。
さぁ、
入って入って！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hello!
text_block_list.orig_text: こんにちはー！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Oh, hi Djeeta!
Your seat's just over there.
Give me a shout when you're ready to order!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃいませー！　
あら、
ジータじゃない。
席ならあそこに取ってあるから、
注文が決まったら
呼んでちょうだい！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Okay-dokey!
Where's the menu...
Ah, here we go. Anything you fancy in particular?
choice_data_list: Whatever my lovely and reliable big sister likes most.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！
えーっとメニューメニュー……
はい、
これ。
何か食べたいものはある？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Let's see here—
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだなー
お姉ちゃんの好きなものはー……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a minute!
Was that your way of teasing me, you little rascal?
Sheesh. Let's stick to normal names, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
違う！
ひょっとして今、
私のことからかったでしょ？
もう……ちゃんと名前で呼んでよね？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Sorry.
That was just my way of getting back at you. Did I surprise you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふっ、
冗談だよー
私をからかったお返し。
びっくりした？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Anyway.
If you want recs, then this and this are really good here.
Let's get them first, then decide on the rest. Excuse me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっとね、
このお店はこれと、
これが特に美味しいんだ！
とりあえず二つだけ、
先に注文しちゃうね？
すいませーん！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll be right over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！　
少々お待ちをー！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
Is there something on my face? You keep staring.
choice_data_list: It's nice to see you're having fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうしたの？
じーっと見てるけど、
私の顔に何かついてる？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Is that the impression I gave you?
Hmm... Well, you're not wrong. 
I'm having a bunch of fun right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が楽しそう……？
うん……
私ね、
今とっても楽しいよ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I was all on my own up until recently.
Being able to laugh and joke away with crewmates
was something I could only fantasize about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな風に仲間と冗談を言い合うなんて、
ちょっと前までは想像するだけだったから……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Here we are now, though.
I've got a precious comrade right in front of me.
There's no way I wouldn't be happy about that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも今は、
こうして気の合う仲間が……
あなたが目の前にいる。
それがすごく嬉しくて、楽しくて……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And well, that's the whole point of today.
I wanted to let you know that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はね、
この気持ちをあなたに伝えたかったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
From the bottom of my heart. Thank you so much for joining.
Here's to more fun times ahead of us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎空団に入ってくれて、
本当にありがとう！
これからもよろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
There's another reason too, you know.
It's because I'm with you.
Life's been nothing but fun ever since I met you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私が楽しそうなのはね、
あなたがいてくれるからだよ。
だって、
あなたと出会ってから、
楽しい出来事ばっかりだもん。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
I really, really hope that stays the same.
I wanna experience all sorts of new things with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも、
もっと色んなことを、
一緒にたくさん体験していきたいな……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With those thoughts in mind,
Djeeta couldn't help but smile at {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータはそう思いながら、テーブルを共に囲む
{0}に向かって微笑んだ。
